ValidationRule.description: When the End_of_Year_Rebate__c is checked, user must provide complementary information
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
$Profile.Name<>'System Administrator'
&& $Profile.Name<>'Global Delegated Admin'
&& End_of_Year_Rebate__c = true
&& ( ISBLANK(End_of_Year_Rebate_Comments__c)
|| ISBLANK( End_of_Year_Rebate_Amount__c )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide the following fields : End of Year Rebate Amount, End of Year Rebate Comments
